mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dbo.retail_price_manual_changes ( product_guid, barcode, product_name, supplier_name, old_retail_price_tax, new_retail_price_tax, username, rolled_back, created_at ) VALUES ( #{productGuid}, #{barcode}, #{productName}, #{supplierName}, #{oldRetailPriceTax}, #{newRetailPriceTax}, #{username}, #{rolledBack}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, product_guid AS productGuid, barcode, product_name AS productName, supplier_name AS supplierName, old_retail_price_tax AS oldRetailPriceTax, new_retail_price_tax AS newRetailPriceTax, username, rolled_back AS rolledBack, created_at AS createdAt FROM dbo.retail_price_manual_changes WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, product_guid AS productGuid, barcode, product_name AS productName, supplier_name AS supplierName, old_retail_price_tax AS oldRetailPriceTax, new_retail_price_tax AS newRetailPriceTax, username, rolled_back AS rolledBack, created_at AS createdAt FROM dbo.retail_price_manual_changes ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
